items.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
verses:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty!
God over all who rules eternity.

Holy, holy, holy! all the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee,
Who wert, and art, and ever more shalt be.

Holy, holy, holy! thoʹ the darkness hide Thee,
Thoʹ the eye of sinfulman Thy glory may not see;
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

items.title: Hallelujah, Praise the Father
verses:
Hallelujah, Praise the Father! Amen, Amen, Hallelujah!
Lift your voice, praise the merciful Father, O sing; “Hallelujah!”

Hallelujah, Praise to Jesus! Amen, Amen, Hallelujah!
Lift your voice, praise our Saviour Jesus, O sing; “Hallelujah!”

Hallelujah, Praise the Spirit! Amen, Amen, Hallelujah!
Lift your voice, praise the Holy Spirit, O sing; “Hallelujah!”

Glory, Glory, Hallelujah! Glory, Glory, Hallelujah!
Lift your voice, and sing His praises, “Glory, endless glory!”

items.title: I Love Thy Kingdom, Lord
verses:
I love Thy kingdom, Lord, The house of Thine abode,
The church our blest Redeemer saved With His own precious blood.

I love Thy church, O God! Her walls before Thee stand,
Dear as the apple of Thine eye, And graven on Thy hand.

For her my tears shall fall, For her my prayʹrs ascend,
To her my cares and toils be givʹn, Till toils and cares shall end.

Beyond my highest joy I prize her heavʹnly ways,
Her sweet communion, solemn vows, Her hymns of love and praise.

Sure as Thy truth shall last, To Zion shall be givʹn
The brightest glories earth can yield, And brighter bliss of heavʹn.

items.title: This Is My Fathers World
verses:
This is my Fatherʹs world, And to my listʹning ears,
All nature sings and round me rings The music of the spheres.
This is my Fathers world, I rest me in the thought
Of rocks and trees, of skies and seas; His hand the wonders wrought.

This is my Fatherʹs world, The birds their carols raise;
The morning light, the lily white Declare their Makerʹs praise.
This is my Fathers world, He shines in all thatʹs fair,
In the rustling grass I hear Him pass, He speaks to me evʹry where.

This is my Fatherʹs world, O let me neʹer forget
That though the wrong seems oft so strong, God is the Ruler yet.
This is my Fathers world, The battle is not done,
Jesus who died shall be satisfied, And earth and heaven be one.

items.title: The Spacious Firmament on High
verses:
The spacious firmament on high,
With all the blue ethereal sky,
And spangled heavens, a shining frame,
Their great Original proclaim.
Thʹun wearied sun from day to day
Does his Creatorʹs power display,
And publishes to every land
The work of an almighty hand.

Soon as the evening shades prevail,
The moon takes up the wondrous tale;
And nightly to the listening earth
Repeats the story of her birth;
Whilst all the stars that round her burn,
And all the planets in their turn,
Confirm the tidings as they roll,
And spread the truth from pole to pole.

What thoʹ in solemn silence all
Move round this dark terrestrial ball?
What thoʹ no real voice nor sound
A mid their radiant orbs be found?
In reasonʹs ear they all rejoice,
And utter forth a glorious voice,
Forever singing, as they shine,
“The hand that made us is divine.”

items.title: Joyful, Joyful, We Adore Thee
verses:
All Thy works with joy surround Thee, Earth and heaven reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee, Center of unbroken praise.
Field and forest, vale and mountain, Flowʹry meadow, flashing sea,
Chanting bird and flowing fountain, Call us to rejoice in Thee.

Thou art giving and forgiving, Ever blessing, ever blest,
Wellspring of the joy of living, Ocean depth of happy rest!
Thou our everlasting Father, All who live in love are Thine,
Teach us how to love each other, Lift us to the joy divine.

Mortals, join the happy chorus Which the morning stars began;
Father love is reigning oʹer us, Brother love binds man to man.
Ever singing, march we onward, Victors in the midst of strife,
Joyful music leads us sunward In the triumph song of life.
items.lyrics:

Hearts unfold like flowers before Thee, Opening to the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and sadness, Drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness, Fill us with the light of day.

items.title: O Come and Sing Unto the Lord
verses:
O come and sing unto the Lord,
To Him our voices raise;
Let us in our most joyful songs
The Lord, our Saviour praise.

Before His presence let us come
With praise and thankful voice,
Let us sing psalms to Him with grace,
With grateful hearts rejoice.

The Lord our God is King of Kings,
Above all gods His throne;
The depths of earth are in His hand,
The mountains are His own.

To Him the spacious sea belongs,
He made its waves and tides;
And by His hand the rising land
Was formed, and still abides.

O come, and bowing down to Him
Our worship let us bring;
Yea, let us kneel before the Lord,
Our Maker and our King.

items.title: All People That on Earth Do Dwell
verses:
All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice,
Him serve with fear, His praise forth tell;
Come ye before Him and rejoice.

Oh, enter then His gates with praise,
Approach with joy His courts unto,
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

For why? the Lord our God is good,
His mercy is forever sure,
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

I rejoice, for Jesus walketh by my side,
In His presence peace and happiness ʹabide,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! In His presence peace and happiness abide

To the fount of living waters He will guide,
For His bounteous blessings leave me satisfied,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! For His bounteous blessings leave me satisfied.

May I praise Him all the passing of my days,
And forever strive to follow in His ways,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! And forever strive to follow in His ways.

He has promised He will lead me all the way,
From Godʹs holy house Iʹll never go a stray,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! From Godʹs holy house Iʹll never go astray.

And wipe my weeping eyes, And wipe my weeping eyes,

items.title: Welcome, Delightful Morn
verses:
Welcome, delightful morn, Thou day of sacred rest!
I hail thy kind return; Lord, make these moments blest;
From the low plane of mortal toys,
I soar to reach immortal joys,
I soar to reach immortal joys.

Now may the King descend, And fill His throne with grace,
Thy scepter, Lord, extends, While saints address Thy face;
Let sinners feel Thy quickening word,
And learn to know and fear the Lord,
And learn to know and fear the Lord.

items.title: Ye Servants of God
verses:
God ruleth on high, almighty to save;
And still He is nigh His presence we have,
The great congregation His triumph shall sing,
Ascribing salvation to Jesus our King.

“Salvation to God, who sits on the throne,”
Let all Cry aloud, and honor the Son,
The praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,
Fall down on their faces, and worship the Lamb.

Then let us and give Him His right,
All glory and power, all wisdom and might,
All honor and blessing, with angels above,
And thanks never ceasing, for infinite love.

verses:

Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all;
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,

Well join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all;
Weʹll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.

items.title: The Half Has Never Been Told
verses:
I know I love Thee better, Lord, Than any earthly joy;
For Thou hast given me the peace Which nothing can destroy.
The half has never yet been told, Of love so full and free!
The half has never yet been told, The blood it cleanseth me!

I know that Thou art nearer still Than any earthIy throng;
And sweeter is the thought of Thee Than any lovely song.
The half has never yet been told, Of love so full and free!
The half has never yet been told, The blood it cleanseth me!

Thou hast put gladness in my heart; Then may I well be glad!
Without the secret of Thy love I could not but be sad.
The half has never yet been told, Of love so full and free!
The half has never yet been told, The blood it cleanseth me!

O Saviour, precious Saviour mine! What will Thy presence be,
If such a life of joy can crown Our walk on earth with Thee?
The half has never yet been told, Of love so full and free!
The half has never yet been told, The blood it cleanseth me!

items.title: When We All Get to Heaven
verses:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus, Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed, Heʹll prepare for us a place.

When we all get to heaven, What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus, Weʹll sing and shout the victory.

While we walk the pilgrim pathway, Clouds will overspread the sky,
But when travʹling days are over, Not a shadow, not a sigh.

When we all get to heaven, What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus, Weʹll sing and shout the victory.

Let us then be true and faithful, Trusting, serving evʹry day,
Just one glimpse of Him in glory Will the toils of life repay.

When we all get to heaven, What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus, Weʹll sing and shout the victory.

Onward to the prize before us! Soon His beauty weʹll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open; We shall tread the streets of gold.

When we all get to heaven, What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus, Weʹll sing and shout the victory.

items.title: Thine Is the Glory
verses:
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring Son,
Endless is the victʹry Thou oʹer death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment Rolled the stone a Way,
Kept the folded graveclothes Where Thy body lay.
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring son;
Endless is the victry Thou oʹer death hast won.

No more we doubt Thee, Glorious Prince of life!
Life is naught without Thee; Aid us in our strifes
Make us more than conquʹrors, Throʹ Thy deathless love,
Bring us safe throʹ Jordan To Thy home ʹabove.
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring son;
Endless is the victry Thou oʹer death hast won.
items.lyrics:
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring Son,
Endless is the victʹry Thou oʹer death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment Rolled the stone a Way,
Kept the folded graveclothes Where Thy body lay.
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring son;
Endless is the victry Thou oʹer death hast won.

Lo! Jesus meets us, Risen from the tomb;
Lovingly He greets us, Scatters fear and gloom;
Let His church with gladness Hymns of triumph sing,
For her Lord now liveth, Death hath lost its sting.
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring son;
Endless is the victry Thou oʹer death hast won.

No more we doubt Thee, Glorious Prince of life!
Life is naught without Thee; Aid us in our strifes
Make us more than conquʹrors, Throʹ Thy deathless love,
Bring us safe throʹ Jordan To Thy home ʹabove.
Thine is the glory, Risen, conquʹring son;
Endless is the victry Thou oʹer death hast won.

items.title: All Hail the Power of Jesusʹ Name
verses:
All hail the power of Jesusʹ name! Let angels prostrate fall,
Let angels prostrate fall; Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

Ye chosen seed of Israelʹs race, Ye ransomed from the fall,
Ye ransomed from the fall; Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

Let every kindred, every tribe, On this terrestrial ball,
On this terrestrial ball, To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

O that with yonder sacred throng We at His feet may fall,
We at His feet may fall We‘ll jon the everlasting song,
And crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him,
And crown Him Lord of all.

items.title: Fairest Lord Jesus
verses:
Fairest Lord Jesus, Ruler of all nature,
O thou of God and man the Son; Thee will I cherish,
Thee will I honor, Thou, my soulʹs glory, joy, and crown.

Fair are the meadows, Fairer still the woodlands,
Robed in the blooming garb of spring; Jesus is fairer,
Jesus is purer, Who makes the woeful heart to sing.

Fair is the sunshine, Fairer still the moonlight
And all the twinkling, starry host, Jesus shines brighter,
Jesus shines purer Than all the angels heaven can boast.

Beautiful Saviour, Lord of all nations,
Son of God and Son of man! Glory and honor,
Praise, adoration, Now and forevermore be Thine!

items.title: There Is a Fountain Dear
verses:
There is a fountain dear, With water sweet and clear.
Each day at morn Iʹm sureIy blessed, as by Godʹs stream I rest.
There, far from all lifeʹs troubling ills, with peaceful balm my soul He fills.

Jesus, the noblest friend, Lovingly clasps my hand,
Each day with Him, so kind and sweet, in earnest prayer I seek.
His words mean all the world to me, like precious gold theyʹll treasured be.

Armed with the Word of God, Strong shall I ever be.
From evilʹs might Iʹll take no flight, thy Spirit strengthens me.
Thy Word is like a banner free, that leads me on to heaven and Thee.

Then face to face with Thee, I see clear all my sins.
No secret thought lies unrevealed, nor hidden sin concealed.
Refreshed and free I come to Thee, Thou gentle man of Galilee.

Blessʹd Jesus, may Thy Word Fill me with life anew,
With prayʹrful heart Iʹll worship Thee and learn Thy ways to do.
And so through all my earthly days, Iʹll work for Thee and sing Thy praise.

items.title: Oh, that the Lord Would Guide My Ways
verses:
Oh, that the Lord would guide my ways, To keep His statutes still!
Oh, that my God would grant me peace To know and do His will!

Order my footsteps by Thy word, And make my heart sincere;
Let sin have no dominion, Lord, But keep my conscience clear.

Assist my soul, too apt to stray, A stricter watch to keep;
And, should I eʹer forget Thy way, Restore Thy wandering sheep.

Make me to walk in Thy commands; ʹTis a delightful road,
Nor let my lips, or heart, or hands Offend against my God.

items.title: Wonderful Words of Life
Godʹs Law Is Perfect and Gives Life
verses:
Godʹs law is perfect and gives life, Revives the weary soul,
Godʹs testimonies are all sure, Wisdom for all to hold.
The statutes of God are just, And give to the heart delight,
Godʹs precepts are direct and pure, And give the eyes clear sight.

The fear of God is always clear, Enduring as the sun,
The judgments of the Lord are true, And righteous evʹry one.
And even more to be desired, Than gold, than the finest gold,
And sweeter than the honeycomb, The words God spoke of old.

Your servant finds enlightenment, By means of them, O Lord,
And in the keeping of Your law, There is a great reward.
Let all my words and my thoughts, My Lord, my Redeemer,
Might, Find favor now and always win Acceptance in Your sight.

items.title: Speak, Lord, in the Stillness
verses:
Speak, Lord, in the stillness, While I wait on Thee;
Hushed my heart to listen In expectancy.

Speak, O blessed Master, In this quiet hour,
Let me see Thy face, Lord, Feel Thy touch of power.

For the words Thou speakest, “They are life” indeed;
Living Bread from heaven, Now my spirit feed!

All to Thee is yielded, I am not my own
Blissful, glad surrender, I am Thine alone.

Fill me with the knowledge Of Thy glorious will;
All Thine own good pleasure In my life fulfill.

items.title: I Am So Glad that Our Father
verses:
I am so glad that our Father in heavʹn,
Tells of His love in the Book He has giv‘n,
Wonderful things in the Bible see,
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

Thoʹ I forget Him and wander away,
Kindly He follows wherever I stray;
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

Jesus loves me and I know I love Him,
Love brought Him down my poor soul to redeem;
Yes, it was love made Him die on the tree,
Oh, I am certain that Jesus loves me.

I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

Oh, if thereʹs only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be;
“Oh, what a wonder that Jesus loves me.ʺ

I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

items.title: Through the Love of God Our Saviour
verses:
Through the love of God our Saviour All will be well;
Free and changeless is His favor, All, all well.
Precious is the blood that healed us, Perfect is the grace that sealed us,
Strong the hand stretched out to shield us; All must be well.

Though we pass through tribuIation, All will be well,
Ours is such a full salvation, All, all is well.
Happy, still in God confiding, Fruitful, if in Christ abiding;
Holy, through the Spiritʹs guiding, All must be well.

We expect a bright tomorrow, All will be well;
Faith can sing through days of sorrow “AI, all is well.”
On our Fatherʹs love reIlying, Jesus every need supplying,
Or in lving or in dying, All must be well.

items.title: The Ninety and Nine
verses:
There were ninety and nine that safeIy lay In the shelter of the fold,
But one was out on the hills away, Far off from the gates of gold
Away on the mountains wild and bare,
Away from the tender Shepherdʹs care, Away from the tender Shepherdʹs care.

“Lord, Thou hast here Thy ninety and nine; Are they not enough for Thee?”
But the Shepherd made answer; “This of mine Has wandered away from me,
And although the road be rough and steep,
I go to the desert to find my sheep, I go to the desert to find my sheep.”

But none of the ransomed ever knew How deep were the waters crossed;
Nor how dark was the night that the Lord passed throʹ Ere He found His sheep that was lost.
Out in the desert He heard its cry
Sick and helpless and ready to die, Sick and helpless, and ready to die.

“Lord, whence are those blooddrops all the way That mark out the mountainʹs track?”
“They were shed for one who had gone astray Ere the Shepherd could bring him back.”
“Lord, whence are Thy hands so rent and torn?”
“Theyʹre pierced tonight by many a thorn; Theyʹre pierced tonight by many a thorn.

But all throʹ the mountains thunder rivʹn, And up from the rocky steep,
There arose a glad cry to the gate of heavʹn,“Rejoice! I have found my sheep!”
And the angels echoed around the throne,
“Rejoice, for the Lord brings back His own! Rejoice, for the Lord brings back His own!”

items.title: In Tenderness He Sought Me
verses:
In tenderness He sought me, Weary and sick with sin,
And on His shoulders brought me Back to His fold again,
While angels in His presence sang Until the courts of heaven rang.

O the love that sought me! O the blood that bought me!
O the grace that brought me to the fold.
Wondrous grace that brought me to the fold!

He washed the bleeding sin wounds And poured in oil and wine;
He whispered to assure me, "I‘ve found thee, thou art mine.”
I never heard a sweeter voice; It made my aching heart rejoice!

O the love that sought me! O the blood that bought me!
O the grace that brought me to the fold.
Wondrous grace that brought me to the fold!

Iʹm sitting in His presence, The sunshine of His face,
While with adoring wonder His blessings I retrace.
It seems as if eternal days Are far too short to sound His praise.

O the love that sought me! O the blood that bought me!
O the grace that brought me to the fold.
Wondrous grace that brought me to the fold!

So while the hours are passing, All now is perfect rest;
Iʹm waiting for the moring, The brightest and the best,
When He will call us to His side To be with Him, His spotless Bride.

O the love that sought me! O the blood that bought me!
O the grace that brought me to the fold.
Wondrous grace that brought me to the fold!

items.title: Seeking for Me
verses:
Jesus, my Saviour, to Bethlehem came,
Born in a manger to sorrow and shame;
O, it was wonderful blest be His name!
Seeking for me, for me! Seeking for me, for me!
Seeking for me, for me! O it was wonderful
blest be His name! Seeking for me, for me!

Jesus, my Saviour, on Calvaryʹs tree,
Paid the great debt and my soul He set free;
O it was wonderful how could it be?
Dying for me, for me! Dying for me, for me!
Dying for me, for me! O it was wonderful
how could it be? Dying for me, for me!

Jesus, my Saviour, the same as of old,
While I was wand‘ring afar from the fold,
Gently and long did He plead with my soul,
Calling for me, for me! Calling for me, for me!
Calling for me, for me! Gently and long did
He plead with my soul, Calling for me, for me!

Jesus, my Saviour, shall come from on high
Sweet is the promise as weary years fly,
O I shall see Him descend from the sky,
Coming for me, for me! Coming for me, for me!
Coming for me, for me! O I shall see Him
descend from the sky, Coming for for me!

items.title: Christ Receiveth Sinful Men
verses:
Sinners Jesus will receive; Sound this word of grace to all
Who the heavʹnly pathway leave, All who linger, all who fall.

Sing it oʹer and oʹer again, Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain; Christ receiveth sinful men.

Come, and He will give you rest; Trust Him, for His word is plain,
He will take the sinfulest; Christ receiveth sinful men.

Sing it oʹer and oʹer again, Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain; Christ receiveth sinful men.

Christ receiveth sinful men, Even me with all my sin,
Purged from evʹry spot and stain, Heavʹn with Him I enter in.

Sing it oʹer and oʹer again, Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain; Christ receiveth sinful men.

items.title: Sweeping Through the Gates
verses:
Who, who are these beside the chilly wave, Just on the borders of the silent grave,
Shouting Jesusʹ powʹr to save, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb”?

Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb,”
Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

These, these are they who, in their youthful days, Found Jesus early, and in wisdomʹs ways
Proved the fulness of His grace, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb,”
Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

These, these are they who, in afflictionʹs woes, Ever have found in Jesus calm repose,
Such as from a pure heart flows, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb,”
Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

These, these are they who, in the conflict dire, Boldly have stood amid the hottest fire,
Jesus now says, “Come up highʹr,” “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb,”
Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

Safe, safe upon the evershining shore, Sin, pain, and death, and sorrow all are oʹer,
Happy now and evermore, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb,”
Sweeping through the gates of the New Jerusalem, “Washed in the blood of the Lamb.”

items.title: Jesus Is Tenderly Calling
Joy Cometh in the Morning
verses:
Oh, weary pilgrim, lift your head; For joy cometh in the morning!
For God in His own Word hath said That joy cometh in the morning!

Joy cometh in the moming! Joy cometh in the morning!
Weeping may endure for a night, But joy cometh in the morning!

Ye trembling saints, dismiss your fears; For joy cometh in the morning!
Oh, weeping mourner, dry your tears; For joy cometh in the morning!

Joy cometh in the moming! Joy cometh in the morning!
Weeping may endure for a night, But joy cometh in the morning!

Let evʹry burdenʹd soul look up; For joy cometh in the morning!
And evʹry trembling sinner hope; For joy cometh in the morning!

Joy cometh in the moming! Joy cometh in the morning!
Weeping may endure for a night, But joy cometh in the morning!

items.title: Whispering Hope
verses:
When amid lifeʹs busy thronging Wearied and lonely you sigh,
When for your soulʹs deepest longing Naught to bring comfort is nigh;
Hark, on the listʹning ear falling, Comes a word tender and true,
List to a gentle voice calling, Bringing a message for you.

Whispering hope, Oh, how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.

All the worldʹs glamouring pleasures Only deceive and enchain;
True and unperishing treasures There seek ye ever in vain.
Come, lift your eyes to the mountains, And your soulʹs yearning shall cease,
Drink at the lifegiving fountains, There to find rest and sweet peace.

Whispering hope, Oh, how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.
items.lyrics:
When amid lifeʹs busy thronging Wearied and lonely you sigh,
When for your soulʹs deepest longing Naught to bring comfort is nigh;
Hark, on the listʹning ear falling, Comes a word tender and true,
List to a gentle voice calling, Bringing a message for you.

Whispering hope, Oh, how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.

All the worldʹs glamouring pleasures Only deceive and enchain;
True and unperishing treasures There seek ye ever in vain.
Come, lift your eyes to the mountains, And your soulʹs yearning shall cease,
Drink at the lifegiving fountains, There to find rest and sweet peace.

Whispering hope, Oh, how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.

items.title: Though Your Sins Be As Scarlet
verses:
“Thoʹ your sins be as scarlet, They shall be as white as snow, as snow;
Thoʹ they be red like crimson, They shall be as wool;”
“Thoʹ your sins be as scarlet, Thoʹ your sins be as scarlet,
They shall be as white as snow, They shall be as as snow.”

Hear the voice that entreats you, Oh, retum ye unto God! to God!
He is of great compassion, And of wondrous love;
Hear the voice that entreats you, Hear the voice that entreats you,
Oh, return ye unto God! Oh, retum ye unto God!

Heʹll forgive your transgressions, And remember them no more! no more,
“Look unto me ye people,” Saith the Lord your God,
He‘ll forgive your transgressions, Heʹll forgive your transgressions,
And remember them no more, And remember them no more.

items.title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say
verses:
I heard the voice of Jesus say, “Behold, I freely give
The living water, thirsty one, Stoop down, and drink, and live.”
I came to Jesus, and I drank Of that lifegiving stream;
My thirst was quenchʹd, my soul revived, And now I live in Him.

I heard the voice of Jesus say, “I am this dark worldʹs light;
Look unto me, thy morn shall rise, And all thy day be bright.”
I looked to Jesus, and I found In Him my Star, my Sun,
And in that light of life Iʹll walk Till travʹling days are done.

items.title: Nothing but the Blood
I Will Praise Him
verses:
When I saw the cleansing fountain Open wide for all my sin,
I obeyed the Spirit‘s wooing, When He said, “Wilt thou be clean?”

I will praise Him! I will praise Him! Praise the Lamb for sinners slain;
Give Him glory, all ye people, For His blood can wash away each stain.

Blessed be the name of Jesus! Iʹm so glad He took me in,
Heʹs forgiven my transgressions, He has cleansed my heart from sin.

I will praise Him! I will praise Him! Praise the Lamb for sinners slain;
Give Him glory, all ye people, For His blood can wash away each stain.

items.title: There Is Power in the Blood
verses:
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
Thereʹs powʹr in the blood, in the blood,
Would you live daily His praises to sing?

Thereʹs wonderful powʹr in the blood.
There is powʹr, powʹr, Wonder working powʹr In the blood of the Lamb;
There is powʹr, powʹr, Wonder working powʹr In the precious blood of the Lamb.

items.title: Blessed Be the Fountain
Are You Washed in the Blood?
verses:
Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?

Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are You washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb? Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

Are you walking daily by the Saviourʹs side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?

Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are You washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb? Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright,

And be washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are You washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb? Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;
Thereʹs a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,

O be washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are You washed in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb? Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

items.title: Weeping Will Not Save Me!
verses:
Weeping will not save me! Though my face were bathed in tears,
That could not allay my fears, Could not wash the sins of years!
Weeping will not save me.

Jesus wept and died for me, Jesus suffered on the tree;
Jesus waits to make me free; He alone can save me!

Working will not save me! Purest deeds that I can do,
Holiest thoughts and feelings too, Cannot form my soul anew!
Working will not save me.

Jesus wept and died for me, Jesus suffered on the tree;
Jesus waits to make me free; He alone can save me!

items.title: Come, Ye Sinners, Poor and Needy
verses:
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy, Weak and wounded, sick and sore,
Jesus ready stands to save you, Full of pity, love, and powʹr,
He is able, He is able, He is willing doubt no more.

items.title: Jesus Christ Healed My Sight
verses:
O long, Iʹve walked the road of sin With blindness in my eyes;
But when the Lord my heart came in, He did show me the light.

Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but, Hallelujah, now I see!
Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but now I see!

Since Jesus Christ has given me sight, I now can see His face;
And with Him thereʹs no dark of night, In that eternal place.

Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but, Hallelujah, now I see!
Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but now I see!

The Lordʹs True Light turns night to day, What joy shines in my face,
With Him IʹIl walk the heavenly way, To witness all His grace.

Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but, Hallelujah, now I see!
Jesus Christ healed my sight, I was blind, but now I see!

items.title: Out of My Bondage, Sorrow, and Night
verses:
Out of my shameful failure and loss, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross, Jesus, I come to Thee,
Out of earthʹs sorrows into Thy balm, Out of lifeʹs storms and into Thy calm,
Out of distress to jubilant psalm, Jesus, I come to Thee.

Out of unrest and arrogant pride, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide, Jesus, I come to Thee,
Out of my self to dwell in Thy love, Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove, Jesus, I come to Thee.

Out of the fear and dread of the tomb, Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come,
Into the joy and light of Thy home, Jesus, I come to Thee,
Out of the depths of ruin untold, Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold,
Ever Thy glorious face to behold, Jesus, I come to Thee.

Out of my sin and into Thyself, Jesus, I come to Thee.

items.title: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross
verses:
Jesus keep me near the cross, There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream, Flows from Calvʹryʹs mountain.

In the cross, in the cross Be my glory ever,
Till my rapturʹd soul shall find Rest beyond the river.

Near the cross, a trembling soul, Love and mercy found me;
There the Bright and Morning Star Shed His beams around me.

In the cross, in the cross Be my glory ever,
Till my rapturʹd soul shall find Rest beyond the river.

Near the cross! O Lamb of God, Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day With its shadow oʹer me.

In the cross, in the cross Be my glory ever,
Till my rapturʹd soul shall find Rest beyond the river.

Near the cross! IʹllI watch and wait, Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand, Just beyond the river.

In the cross, in the cross Be my glory ever,
Till my rapturʹd soul shall find Rest beyond the river.

items.title: All the Way to Calvary
verses:
Oh, how dark the night that wrapt my spirit round!
Oh, how deep the woe my Saviour found
When He walked across the waters of my soul,
Bade my night disperse and made me whole!

All the way to Calvary He went for me, He went for me, He went for me;
All the way to Calvary He went for me, He died to set me free.

Tremblingly a sinner bowed before His face,
Naught I knew of pardon, Godʹs free grace,
Heard a voice so melting, “Cease thy wild regret,
Jesus bought thy pardon, paid thy debt.”

All the way to Calvary He went for me, He went for me, He went for me;
All the way to Calvary He went for me, He died to set me free.

When He left His throne for Calvary,

Praise His name forever, make it known.

items.title: Jesus Only Is Our Message
verses:
Jesus onIy is our Message, Jesus all our theme shall be;
We will lift up Jesus ever, Jesus onIy will we see.

Jesus only, Jesus ever, Jesus all in all we sing,
Saviour, Sanctifier, and Healer, Glorious Lord and coming King.

Jesus only is our Saviour, All our guilt He bore away,
All our righteousness He gives us, All our strength from day to day.

Jesus only, Jesus ever, Jesus all in all we sing,
Saviour, Sanctifier, and Healer, Glorious Lord and coming King.

Jesus is our Sanctifier, Cleansing us from self and sin,
And with all His Spiritʹs fullness, Filling all our hearts within.

Jesus only, Jesus ever, Jesus all in all we sing,
Saviour, Sanctifier, and Healer, Glorious Lord and coming King.

Jesus onIy is our Healer, All our sicknesses He bare,
And His risen life and fullness, All His members still may share.

Jesus only, Jesus ever, Jesus all in all we sing,
Saviour, Sanctifier, and Healer, Glorious Lord and coming King.

items.title: Rock of Ages, Cleft for Me
verses:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowʹd,
Be of sin the double cure,
Save me from its guilt and power.
Be of sin the double cure,
Save me from its guilt and power.
Simply to Thy cross I cling.

Could my tears forever flow,
Could my zeal no languor know
These for sin could not atone,
Thou must save, and Thou alone,
In my hand no price I bring,
Simply to Thy cross I cling.
In my hand no price I bring,

While I draw this fleeting breath,
When mine eyes shall close in death,
When I rise to worlds unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy throne
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

items.title: Jesus Paid It All
verses:
I hear the Saviour say, “Thy strength indeed is small,
Child of weakness, watch and pray, Find in Me thine all in all.”

Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain, He washed it white as snow.

Lord, now indeed I find Thy power, and Thine alone,
Can change the leperʹs spots, And melt the heart of stone.

Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain, He washed it white as snow.

For nothing good have I Whereby Thy grace to claim
Iʹll wash my garments white In the blood of Calvaryʹs Lamb.

Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain, He washed it white as snow.

When from my dying bed My ransomed soul shall rise,
Then “Jesus paid it all” Shall rend the vaulted skies.

Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain, He washed it white as snow.

And when before the throne I stand in Him complete,
Iʹll lay my trophies down, All down at Jesusʹ feet.

Jesus paid it all, All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain, He washed it white as snow.

items.title: God Is Love
verses:
For God so loved the men of earth, He gave His onIy son,
To save, redeem, reveal His grace And love to evʹry one.

I know that God is truIy love; He pardoned even me,
Prepares my soul for life above; I know that God is love.

His love, so great, erased my sin, Though it was inky black,
And Iʹd rebelled against His will, His love has drawn me back.

I know that God is truIy love; He pardoned even me,
Prepares my soul for life above; I know that God is love.

The Son of God was crucified, Hung on the cross for me,
O what a price He paid for men, What love, what agony!

I know that God is truIy love; He pardoned even me,
Prepares my soul for life above; I know that God is love.

Godʹs mercy is so wide, so deep! O sinner, hear His call!
Believe in Him without delay, You owe to Him your all.

I know that God is truIy love; He pardoned even me,
Prepares my soul for life above; I know that God is love.

items.title: From Darkness into the Light
verses:
Hallelujah, Praise the Lord! Hallelujah, Praise the Lord!
He delivers me, From darkness into the light,
Come ye to the True Church, come; O rejoice! O rejoice!
Canaanʹs blessings He bestows,
Oh, how He loves me, though I am nothing,
With His Holy spirit here, He filleth me.

Hallelujah, Praise the Lord! Hallelujah, Praise the Lord!
For He leadeth me, Out of Babylon well flee,
Gave the precious Comforter, O great love! O great love!
What a precious gift for me,
Throʹ His dear grace He calls me to serve Him,
So Iʹll spread His word afar, unto all men.

Hallelujah, Praise the Lord! Hallelujah, Praise the Lord!
For He guides my way, Clearly shows the path to take,
Lift your eyes to heavn above, O prepare! O prepare!
Bring your vessels filled with oil,
Trim all your lamps and keep yourself ready,
For the Bridegroom will return, For you and me.

items.title: Jesus Frees Me
verses:
So now as I go on lifeʹs difficult way,
Godʹs spirit abides with me day after day,
A son of God now and forever IʹIl be,
Oh glory to Jesus, Iʹm free!

Now I am free! Forever free! Thus will my proclamation be;
Iʹm no longer bound by the shackles of sin! Oh glory to Jesus! Iʹm free!
items.lyrics:
I once was a sinner with turmoil within,
Condemned, trapped and powerless, living in sin;
But then my Lord came down and died on the tree,
Oh glory! Iʹm happy and free.

Now I am free! Forever free! Thus will my proclamation be;
Iʹm no longer bound by the shackles of sin! Oh glory to Jesus! Iʹm free!

I tried on my own to fight Satanʹs attacks,
With every step forward I fell three steps back;
But now I have Godʹs spirit living in me,
Oh glory! Iʹm fearless and free.

Now I am free! Forever free! Thus will my proclamation be;
Iʹm no longer bound by the shackles of sin! Oh glory to Jesus! Iʹm free!

Oh glory to Jesus, Iʹm free!

items.title: Blow Ye the Trumpet, Blow
verses:
Blow ye the trumpet, blow! The gladly solemn sound
Let all the nations know, To earthʹs remotest bound,

The year of jubilee is come! The year of jubilee is come!
Return, ye ransomed sinners, home.

Jesus, our great High Priest, Hath full atonement made,
Ye weaIy spirits, rest, Ye mournful souls, be glad;

The year of jubilee is come! The year of jubilee is come!
Return, ye ransomed sinners, home.

Ye slaves of sin and hell, Your liberty receive
And safe in Jesus dwell And blest in Jesus live,

The year of jubilee is come! The year of jubilee is come!
Return, ye ransomed sinners, home.

Ye who have sold for nought Your heritage above,
Receive it back unbought, The gift of Jesusʹ love;

The year of jubilee is come! The year of jubilee is come!
Return, ye ransomed sinners, home.

items.title: Just As I Am
verses:
Just as I am, without one plea, But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou biddʹst me come to Thee, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

Just as I am, and waiting not To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee whose blood can cleanse each spot, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

Just as I am, thoʹ tossed about With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings within and fears without, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind; Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

Just as I am, Thou wilt receive, Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve,
Because Thy promise I believe, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

Just as I am, Thy love unknown Hath broken evʹry barrier down,
Now to be Thine, yea, Thine alone, O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

items.title: He Leadeth Me! O Blessed Thoʹt!
verses:
He leadeth me! O blessed thoʹt! O words with heavʹnly comfort fraught!
Whateʹer I do, whereʹer I be, Still ʹtis Godʹs hand that leadeth me!

He leadeth me, He leadeth me, By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follʹwer I would be, For by His hand He leadeth me.

Sometimes ʹmid scenes of deepest gloom, Sometimes where Edenʹs bowers bloom,
By waters still, oʹer troubled sea, Still ʹtis His hand that leadeth me!

He leadeth me, He leadeth me, By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follʹwer I would be, For by His hand He leadeth me.

Lord, I would clasp Thy hand in mine, Nor ever murmur nor repine,
Content, whatever lot I see, Since ʹtis Thy hand that leadeth me!

He leadeth me, He leadeth me, By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follʹwer I would be, For by His hand He leadeth me.

And when my task on earth is done, When, by Thy grace, the victryʹs won,
Eʹen deathʹs cold wave I will not flee, Since God throʹ Jordan leadeth me!

He leadeth me, He leadeth me, By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follʹwer I would be, For by His hand He leadeth me.

items.title: Guide Me, O Thou Great Jehovah
verses:
Open now the crystal fountain, Whence the healing stream doth flow,
Let the fire and cloudy pillar Lead me all my journey through;
Strong Deliverer, strong Deliverer, Be Thou still my strength and shield,
Strong Deliverer, strong Deliverer, Be Thou still my strength and shield.

When I tread the verge of Jordan, Bid my anxious fears subside;
Bear me through the swelling current, Land me safe on Canaanʹs side,
Songs of praises, songs of praises, I will ever give to Thee,
Songs of praises, songs of praises, I will ever give to Thee.

items.title: Let Him Lead
verses:
Walk with joy the heavenly road; let Him lead;
Brightly lit is heaven‘s road,
Toward its gleamping pathway strive,
Never falter, never sigh; let Him lead.

Walk with might the heavenly road; let Him lead;
Seek His grace on heavenʹs road,
Though in life temptations come,
Follow Him and from them run; let Him lead.

Walk with calm the heavenly road; let Him lead;
Hard and long is heavenʹs road,
Pray and trust His guiding light,
Keep it always in your sight; let Him lead.

Walk with peace the heavenly road; let Him lead;
In your sight is heaven‘s road,
Walk by faith until the end,
Til in heaven we may stand; let Him lead.

items.title: Lead, Kindly Light
verses:
Lead, kindly Light! amid thʹencircling gloom, Lead Thou me on;
The night is dark, and I am far from home, Lead Thou me on,
Keep Thou my feet, I do not ask to see
The distant scene; one step enough for me.

I was not ever thus, nor prayed that Thou Shouldst Iead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now, Lead Thou me on,
I loved the garish day, and spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will; Remember not past years.

So long Thy powʹr has blessed me, sure it still Will lead me on
Oʹer moor and fen, oʹer crag and torrent, till The night is gone,
And with the morn those angel faces smile
Which I have loved long since, and lost awhile!

items.title: The Saviour with Me
verses:
I would have the Saviour with me In the onward march of life,
Throʹ the tempest and the sunshine, Throʹ the battle and the strife.

Then my soul shall fear no ill, While He leads me where He will;
I will go without a murmur, And His footsteps follow still.

I would have the Saviour with me, That His eye the way may guide,
Till I reach the vale of Jordan, Till I cross the rolling tide.

Then my soul shall fear no ill, While He leads me where He will;
I will go without a murmur, And His footsteps follow still.

items.title: Tarry with Me, O My Saviour
verses:
Tarry with me, O my Saviour, For the day is passing by;
See! the shades of evening gather, And the night is drawing nigh.

Tarry with me, O my Saviour, Lay my head upon Thy breast
Till the morning, then awake me Morning of eternal rest.

Deeper, deeper grow the shadows, Paler now the glowing west,
Swift the night of death advances; Shall it be the night of rest?

Tarry with me, O my Saviour, Lay my head upon Thy breast
Till the morning, then awake me Morning of eternal rest.

Let me hear Thy voice behind me, Calming all these wild alarms,
Let me, underneath my weakness, Feel the everlasting arms.

Tarry with me, O my Saviour, Lay my head upon Thy breast
Till the morning, then awake me Morning of eternal rest.

Feeble, trembling, fainting, dying, Lord, I cast myself on Thee,
Tarry with me through the darkness; While I sleep, still watch by me.

Tarry with me, O my Saviour, Lay my head upon Thy breast
Till the morning, then awake me Morning of eternal rest.

items.title: Heavenly Sunlight
Thou, My Everlasting Portion
verses:
Thou, my everlasting portion, More than friend or life to me,
All along my pilgrim journey, Saviour, let me walk with Thee.
Close to Thee, close to Thee, Close to Thee, close to Thee;
All along my pilgrim journey, Saviour, let me walk with Thee.

items.title: Lord, My Soul Will Wait for Thee
Teach Me Thy Way, O Lord
verses:
Teach me Thy way, O Lord, Teach me Thy way!
Thy guiding grace afford Teach me Thy way!
Help me to walk aright, More by faith, less by sight;
Lead me with heavʹnly light, Teach me Thy way!

When I am sad at heart, Teach me Thy way!
When earthly joys depart, Teach me Thy way!
In hours of loneliness, In times of dire distress;
In failure or success, Teach me Thy way!

When doubts and fears arise, Teach me Thy way!
When storms oʹer spread the skies, Teach me Thy way!
Shine throʹ the cloud and rain, Throʹ sorrow, toil and pain;
Make Thou my pathway plain, Teach me Thy way!

Long as my life shall last, Teach me Thy way!
Whereʹer my lot be cast, Teach me Thy way!
Until the race is run, Until the journeyʹs done,
Until the crown is won, Teach me Thy way!

items.title: Hold Thou My Hand
verses:
Hold Thou my hand; so weak I am, and helpless,
I dare not take one step without Thy aid;
Hold Thou my hand; for then, O loving Saviour,
No dread of ill shall make my soul afraid.

Hold Thou my hand; and closer, closer draw me
To Thy dear self my hope, my joy, my all;
Hold Thou my hand, lest haply I should wander,
And, missing Thee, my trembling feet should fall.

Hold Thou my hand; the way is dark before me
Without the sunlight of Thy face divine;
But when by faith I catch its radiant glory,
What heights of joy, what rapturous songs are mine!

Hold Thou my hand; that when I reach the margin
Of that lone Tiver Thou didst cross for me,
A heavenly light may flash along its waters,
And evʹry wave like crystal bright shall be.

items.title: Jesus, Saviour, Pilot Me
verses:
When at last I near the shore, And the fearful breakers roar
ʺTwixt me and the peaceful rest, Then, while leaning on Thy breast,
May I hear Thee say to me, “Fear not, I will pilot thee.”

items.title: None but Christ Can Satisfy
verses:
O Christ, in Thee, my soul hath found, And found in Thee alone,
The peace, the joy I sought so long, The bliss till now unknown.

Now none but Christ can satisfy, None other name for me,
Thereʹs love and life and lasting joy, Lord Jesus, found in Thee.

I sighed for rest and happiness, I yearned for them, not Thee;
But while I passed my Saviour by, His love laid hold on me.

Now none but Christ can satisfy, None other name for me,
Thereʹs love and life and lasting joy, Lord Jesus, found in Thee.

I tried the broken cisterns, Lord, But ah! the waters failed!
Eʹen as I stooped to drink they fled, And mocked me as I wailed.

Now none but Christ can satisfy, None other name for me,
Thereʹs love and life and lasting joy, Lord Jesus, found in Thee.

The pleasures lost I sadly mourned, But never wept for Thee,
Till grace my sightless eyes received, Thy loveliness to see.

Now none but Christ can satisfy, None other name for me,
Thereʹs love and life and lasting joy, Lord Jesus, found in Thee.

items.title: Jesus, Thy Name I Love
verses:
When unto Thee I flee, Thou wilt my refuge be,
Jesus my Lord! What need I now to fear?
What earthly grief or care, Since Thou art ever near? Jesus my Lord!

Soon Thou wilt come again, I shall be happy then,
Jesus my Lord! Then Thine own face Iʹll see,
Then I shall like Thee be, Then ever more with Thee, Jesus my Lord!
items.lyrics:
Jesus, Thy name I love, All other names above;
Jesus my Lord! Oh, Thou art all to me,
Nothing to please I see, Nothing apart from Thee, Jesus my Lord!

Jesus deepIy loves me, By His blood He bought me;
Jesus my Lord! Oh, how great is His love;
All other loves above, Love that I daily prove, Jesus my Lord!

When unto Thee I flee, Thou wilt my refuge be,
Jesus my Lord! What need I now to fear?
What earthly grief or care, Since Thou art ever near? Jesus my Lord!

Soon Thou wilt come again, I shall be happy then,
Jesus my Lord! Then Thine own face Iʹll see,
Then I shall like Thee be, Then ever more with Thee, Jesus my Lord!

items.title: The Great Physician
Saviour, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
Hark! The Herald Angels Sing
verses:
Hark! the herald angels sing, “Glory to the newborn King;
Peace on earth, and mercy mild; God and sinners reconciled.”
Joyful, all ye nations, rise, Join the triumph of the skies,
With angelic hosts proclaim, “Christ is born in Bethlehem!”
Hark! the herald angels sing, “Glory to the newborn King.”

Christ, by highest heaven adored, Christ, the everlasting Lord;
Late in time, behold Him come, Offspring of a virgin‘s womb.
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see, Hail thʹincarnate Deity!
Pleased as man with men to dwell, Jesus our Immanuel.
Hark! the herald angels sing, “Glory to the newborn King.”

Hail the heavʹn born Prince of Peace! Hail the Sun of righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings, Risen with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by, Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth, Born to give them second birth.
Hark! the herald angels sing, “Glory to the newborn King.”

items.title: The First Noel, the Angel Did Say
verses:
The first Noel, the angel did say,
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields as they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a dark, starry night that was so deep.
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, Born is the King of Israel.

They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east, beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, Born is the King of Israel.

And by the light of that same star
The wise men came from country far,
To seek for a king was their in tent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, Born is the King of Israel.

Then let us all with one accord
Sing praises to our heavenly Lord
Who hath made heaven and earth of naught,
And with His blood mankind hath bought.
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, Born is the King of Israel.

items.title: At the Cross
verses:
Alas, and did my Saviour bleed And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred head For sinners such as I?

At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away, It was there by faith
I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day!

Was it for crimes that I have done He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity, grace unknown, And love beyond degree!

At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away, It was there by faith
I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day!

Well might the sun in darkness hide, And shut his glories in,
When Christ the mighty Maker died For man the creatureʹs sin.

At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away, It was there by faith
I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day!

But drops of grief can neʹer repay The debt of love I owe;
Here, Lord, I give myself away, ʹTis all that I can do.

At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away, It was there by faith
I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day!

items.title: The Old Rugged Cross
verses:
On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross,
The emblem of suffering and shame,
And I love that old cross where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

Oh, that old rugged cross so despised by the world,
Has a wondrous at traction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

In the old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For ʹtwas on that old cross Jesus suffered and died,
To pardon and sanctify me.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

To the old rugged cross I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear,
Then Heʹll call me some day to my home far away,
Where His glory forever Iʹll share.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

Oh, that old rugged cross so despised by the world,
Has a wondrous at traction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

In the old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For ʹtwas on that old cross Jesus suffered and died,
To pardon and sanctify me.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

To the old rugged cross I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear,
Then Heʹll call me some day to my home far away,
Where His glory forever Iʹll share.

So Iʹll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

items.title: Low in the Grave He Lay
verses:
Low in the grave He lay, Jesus my Saviour! Waiting the coming day,
Jesus my Lord! Up from the grave He arose, With a mighty triumph oʹer His foes;
He arose a victor from the dark domain, And He lives forever with His saints to reign.
He arose He arose! Hallelujah! Christ arose!

Vainly they watch His bed, Jesus my Saviour! Vainly they seal the dead,
Jesus my Lord! Up from the grave He arose, With a mighty triumph oʹer His foes;
He arose a victor from the dark domain, And He lives forever with His saints to reign.
He arose He arose! Hallelujah! Christ arose!

Death cannot keep his prey, Jesus my Saviour! He tore the bars away,
Jesus my Lord! Up from the grave He arose, With a mighty triumph oʹer His foes;
He arose a victor from the dark domain, And He lives forever with His saints to reign.
He arose He arose! Hallelujah! Christ arose!

items.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today
verses:
Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
Sons of men and angels say, Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs, Alleluia!
Sing, ye heavens, and earth, reply, Alleluia!

Lives again our glorious King, Alleluia!
Where, O Death, is now thy sting? Alleluia!
Dying once He all doth save, Alleluia!
Where thy victory, O Grave? Alleluia!

Loveʹs redeeming work is done, Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle won, Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids Him rise, Alleluia!
Christ hath opened Paradise, Alleluia!

Soar we now where Christ has led, Alleluia!
Following our exalted Head, Alleluia!
Made like Him, like Him we rise, Alleluia!
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies, Alleluia!

items.title: The Strife Is Oʹer
verses:
Alleluia! alleluia! alleluia!
The strife is oʹer, the battle done;
The victory of life is won,
The song of triumph has begun; Alleluia!

Alleluia! alleluia! alleluia!
The powers of death have done their worst,
But Christ their legions hath dispersed,
Let shouts of holy joy outburst; Alleluia!

Alleluia! alleluia! alleluia!
The three sad days have guickly sped,
He rises glorious from the dead,
All glory to our rsen Head; Alleluia!

Alleluia! alleluia! alleluia!
Lord, by the stripes which wounded Thee,
From deathʹs dread sting Thy servants free,
That we may live and to Thee; Alleluia!

items.title: On the Mountainʹs Top Appearing
verses:
On the mountainʹs top appearing, Lo! the sacred herald stands,
Welcome news to Zion bearing Zion, long in hostile lands,
Mourning captive, God Himself will loose thy bands,
Mourning captive, God Himself will loose thy bands.

Has thy night been long and mournful? Have thy friends unfaithful proved?
Have thy foes been proud and scornful, By thy sighs and tears unmoved?
Cease thy mourning, Zion still is well beloved;
Cease thy mourning, Zion still is well beloved.

God, thy God, will now restore thee; He Himself appears thy Friend;
All thy foes shall flee before thee, Here their boasts and triumphs end.
Great delivʹrance Zionʹs King will surely send,
Great delivʹrance Zions King will surelIy send.

Peace and joy shall now attend Thee; All thy warfare now is past;
God thy Saviour will defend thee; Victory is thine at last,
All thy conflicts End in everlasting rest,
All thy conflicts End in everlasting rest.

items.title: I Am Praying for You
verses:
I have a Saviour, Heʹs pleading in glory, A dear loving Saviour,
thoʹ earthfriends be few; And now He is watching in tenderness oʹer me,
And, oh, that my Saviour were your Saviour too. For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, For you I am praying, Iʹm praying for you.

I have a Father; to me He has given A hope for eternity,
blessed and true, And soon will He call me to meet Him in heaven,
But, oh, that Heʹd let me bring you with me too! For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, For you I am praying, Iʹm praying for you.

I have a robe; ʹtis resplendent in whiteness, Awaiting in glory
my wondering view; Oh, when I receive it all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one too! For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, For you I am praying, Iʹm praying for you.

When Christ has found you, tell thers the story, That my loving Saviour is
your Saviour too, Then pray that your Saviour may bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered ʹtwas answered for you! For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, For you I am praying, Iʹm praying for you.

verses:
Thereʹll be no dark valley when Jesus comes,
Thereʹll be no dark valley when Jesus comes,
Thereʹll be no dark valley when Jesus comes

Thereʹll be no more sorrow when Jesus comes;

items.title: Rejoice! Rejoice! Our King Is Coming
verses:
Rejoice! Rejoice! our King is coming! And the time will not be long,
Until we hail the radiant dawning, And lift up the glad new song.
Oh, wondrous day! oh, glorious morning, When the Son of Man shall come!
May we with lamps all trimmʹd and burning Gladly welcome His return!

Rejoice! Rejoice! our King is coming! And the time will not be long,
Until we hail the radiant dawning, And lift up the glad new song.

With joy we wait our Kingʹs returning, From His heavʹnly mansions fair,
And with ten thousand saints appearing, We shall meet Him in the air.
Oh, wondrous day! oh, glorious morning, When the Son of Man shall come!
May we with lamps all trimmʹd and burning Gladly welcome His return!

Rejoice! Rejoice! our King is coming! And the time will not be long,
Until we hail the radiant dawning, And lift up the glad new song.

Oh, may we never weary, watching, Never lay our armour down,
Until He come, and with rejoicing Give to each the promised crown.
Oh, wondrous day! oh, glorious morning, When the Son of Man shall come!
May we with lamps all trimmʹd and burning Gladly welcome His return!

Rejoice! Rejoice! our King is coming! And the time will not be long,
Until we hail the radiant dawning, And lift up the glad new song.

items.title: Heʹs Coming Soon
verses:
In these, the closing days of time, What joy the glorious hope affords,
That soon oh, wondrous truth sublime! He shall reign, King of kings and Lord of lords.

Heʹs coming soon, Heʹs coming soon, With joy we welcome His retuming,
It may be morn, it may be night or noon, We know Heʹs coming soon.

The signs around in earth and air, Or painted on the starlit sky,
Godʹs faithful witnesses declare That the coming of the Saviour draweth nigh.

Heʹs coming soon, Heʹs coming soon, With joy we welcome His retuming,
It may be morn, it may be night or noon, We know Heʹs coming soon.

The dead in Christ who ʹneath us lie, In countless numbers, all shall rise,
When throʹ the portals of the sky He shall come to prepare our Paradise.

Heʹs coming soon, Heʹs coming soon, With joy we welcome His retuming,
It may be morn, it may be night or noon, We know Heʹs coming soon.

And we who, living, yet remain, Caught up, shall meet our faithful Lord,
This hope we cherish not in vain, But we comfort one an other by this word.

Heʹs coming soon, Heʹs coming soon, With joy we welcome His retuming,
It may be morn, it may be night or noon, We know Heʹs coming soon.

items.title: My Soul, Be on Thy Guard
verses:
My Soul, be on Thy guard; Ten thousand foes arise;
The hosts of sin are pressing hard to draw thee from the skies.

O watch and fight and pary; The battle neʹer give oʹer,
Renew it boldly evʹry day, And help divine implore.

Neʹer think the victʹry won, Nor lay thine armor down;
Thy arduous work will not be done Till thou obtain thy crown.

Fight on, my soul, till death Shall bring thee to thy God;
Heʹll take thee, at thy parting breath, To His divine abode.

items.title: There‘s a Great Day Coming
verses:
Thereʹs a great day coming, A great day coming,
There‘s a great day coming by and by;
When the saints and the sinners shall be parted right and left,
Are you ready for that day to come?

Are you ready? Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?

Thereʹs a bright day coming, A bright day coming,
There‘s a bright day coming by and by;
But its brightness shall only come to them that love the Lord,
Are you ready for that day to come?

Are you ready? Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?

Thereʹs a sad day coming, A sad day coming,
There‘s a sad day coming by and by;
When the sinner shall hear his doom, “Depart, I know ye not,”
Are you ready for that day to come?

Are you ready? Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready? Are you ready for the judgment day?

items.title: One Day
verses:
One day when heaven was filled with His praises,
One day when sin was as black as could be,
Jesus came forth to be born of a virgin,
Dwelt among men, my example is He!

Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me, Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely forever; One day Heʹs coming O glorious day!

One day they left Him alone in the garden,
One day He rested, from suffering free,
Angels came down oʹer His tomb to keep vigil;
Hope of the hopeless, my Saviour is He!

Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me, Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely forever; One day Heʹs coming O glorious day!

One day the grave could conceal Him no longer,
One day the stone rolled away from the door,
Then He arose, 0ver death He had conquered,
Now is ascended, my Lord evermore!

Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me, Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely forever; One day Heʹs coming O glorious day!

One day the trumpet will sound for His coming,
One day the skies with His glories will shine,
Wonderful day, my beloved ones bringing;
Glorious Saviour, this Jesus is mine!

Living, He loved me, dying, He saved me, Buried, He carried my sins far away,
Rising, He justified freely forever; One day Heʹs coming O glorious day!

items.title: His Grace Aboundeth More
verses:
Oh what a wonderful Saviour, In Jesus, my Lord I have found!
Thoʹ I had sins without number, His grace unto me did abound.

His grace aboundeth more. His grace aboundeth more.
Thoʹ sin abounded in my heart, His grace aboundeth more.

When a poor sinner He found me, No goodness to offer had I;
Often His law I had broken, And merited naught but to die.

His grace aboundeth more. His grace aboundeth more.
Thoʹ sin abounded in my heart, His grace aboundeth more.

Nothing of merit possessing, All helpless before Him I lay;
But in the precious blood flowing, He washʹd all my sinstains away.

His grace aboundeth more. His grace aboundeth more.
Thoʹ sin abounded in my heart, His grace aboundeth more.

In Him my gracious Redeemer, My Prophet, my Priest, and my King;
Mercy I find and forgiveness, My all to his keeping I bring.

His grace aboundeth more. His grace aboundeth more.
Thoʹ sin abounded in my heart, His grace aboundeth more.

How can I keep from rejoicing? I‘ll sing of the joy in my soul,
Praising the love of my Saviour While years of eternity roll.

His grace aboundeth more. His grace aboundeth more.
Thoʹ sin abounded in my heart, His grace aboundeth more.

items.title: Count Your Blessings
Thy Love Jesus
verses:
Day and night do I think of Thy love, Jesus; Height, depth, length, and breadth are so great.
Like a waterfall fresh from above, Jesus, What happiness comes from this spate!
Throʹ Thy love You become flesh on earth, Jesus, Releasing Your throne, bright, on high;
Being born Son of Man, under law, Jesus, Too poor for a place You could lie.

Now my love is poured out at Thy feet, Jesus, You satisfy me more than all,
O, Thy beauty and goodness excel, Jesus, With joy I abide in Thy love.

Like aroma of food is Thy love, Jesus; Let favored ones eat and be filled.
We give thanks for Your death on the cross, Jesus, Such mocking and suffering You willed,
Saving me from my sin and from death, Jesus, Your precious blood washed white as snow,
Sent the Comforter that He might teach, Jesus, So that I might please Thee below.

Now my love is poured out at Thy feet, Jesus, You satisfy me more than all,
O, Thy beauty and goodness excel, Jesus, With joy I abide in Thy love.

Day and night do I pine for Your home, Jesus; The home Youʹre preparing above.
Golden streets, jasper walls, happy place, Jesus, No pain, no more tears, only love.
In Your mercy and grace evermore, Jesus, No blessing as great can be found.
Thy love always remains just the same, Jesus, What glory, what radiance abound.

Now my love is poured out at Thy feet, Jesus, You satisfy me more than all,
O, Thy beauty and goodness excel, Jesus, With joy I abide in Thy love.

Like aroma of food is Thy love, Jesus; Let favored ones eat and be filled.
We give thanks for Your death on the cross, Jesus, Such mocking and suffering You willed,
Saving me from my sin and from death, Jesus, Your precious blood washed white as snow,
Sent the Comforter that He might teach, Jesus, So that I might please Thee below.

Now my love is poured out at Thy feet, Jesus, You satisfy me more than all,
O, Thy beauty and goodness excel, Jesus, With joy I abide in Thy love.

Day and night do I pine for Your home, Jesus; The home Youʹre preparing above.
Golden streets, jasper walls, happy place, Jesus, No pain, no more tears, only love.
In Your mercy and grace evermore, Jesus, No blessing as great can be found.
Thy love always remains just the same, Jesus, What glory, what radiance abound.

Now my love is poured out at Thy feet, Jesus, You satisfy me more than all,
O, Thy beauty and goodness excel, Jesus, With joy I abide in Thy love.

items.title: I Am Coming to the Cross
verses:
I am coming to the cross; I am poor and weak and blind,
I am counting all but dross; I shall full salvation find.

Long my heart has sighed for Thee; Long has evil dwelt within;
Jesus sweetIy speaks to me, “I will cleanse you from all sin.”

Here I give my all to Thee, Friends and time and earthly store,
Soul and body Thine to be, Wholly Thine forevermore.

In the promises I trust; Now I feel the blood applied;
I am prostrate in the dust; I with Christ am crucified.

I am trusting, Lord, in Thee, Dear Lamb of Calvary,
Humbly at the cross I bow; Save me, Jesus, save me now.

items.title: Sometimes a Light Surprises
verses:
Sometimes a light surprises The Christian while he sings,
It is the Lord who rises With healing in His wings.
When comforts are declining He grants the soul again,
A season of clear shining To cheer it after rain.

In holy contemplation, We sweetly then pursue
The theme of Godʹs salvation, And find it ever new;
Set free from present sorrow, We cheerfully can say
Eʹen let thʹunknown tomorrow Bring with it what it may.

items.title: Thank the Father
verses:
Thank the Father, Heʹs the Only God, He redeems me from all my sins.
O dear Lord, my Spirit renew! O praise His name,
Thank Him for His great love. Sing to the Lord, sing joyfully, Sing!
Sing of His love, sing joyfully, Sing! O Hallelujah, Praise His name!

Thank the Father, Heʹs the Only God, Who fulfils the needs of my soul.
O dear Lord, send Thy Manna to me! O praise His name,
Thank Him for His great love. Sing to the Lord, sing joyfully, Sing!
Sing of His love, sing joyfully, Sing! O Hallelujah, Praise His name!

items.title: O, My Redeemer
verses:
O my Redeemer, What a Friend Thou art to me!
Oh, what a refuge I have found in Thee! When the way was dreary,
And my heart was sore oppressʹd, ʹTwas Thy voice that lullʹd me,
To a calm, sweet rest. Nearer, draw nearer, Till my soul is lost in Thee;
Nearer, draw nearer, Blessed Lord, to me.

When in their beauty, Stars unveil their silver light,
Then, O my Saviour, Give me songs at night Songs of yonder mansions,
Where the dear ones, gone before, Sing Thy praise forever,
On that peaceful shore. Nearer, draw nearer, Till my soul is lost in Thee;
Nearer, draw nearer, Blessed Lord, to me.

When, in the silence I shall hear Thy call In Thine arms reposing,
Let me breathe my life away, And awake triumphant,
In eternal day. Nearer, draw nearer, Till my soul is lost in Thee;
Nearer, draw nearer, Blessed Lord, to me.

items.title: Amazing Grace
verses:
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound, That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost but now am found, Was blind, but now I see.

ʹTwas grace that taught my heart to fear, And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear The hour I first believed!

The Lord has promised good to me, His word my hope secures,
He will my shield and portion be, As long as life endures.

Throʹ many dangers, toils, and snares, I have already come,
ʹTis grace hath broʹt me safe thus far, And grace will lead me home.

Yes, when this heart and flesh shall fail, And mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess within the vale, A life of joy and peace.

When weʹve been there ten thousand years, Bright shining as the sun,
Weʹve no less days to sing Godʹs praise Than when we first begun.

items.title: Ivory Palaces
verses:
My Lord has garments so wondrous fine, And myrrh their texture fills;
Its fragrance reached to this heart of mine, With joy my being thrills.

Out of the ivory palaces Into a world of woe,
Only His great eternal love Made my Saviour go.

His life has also its sorrows sore, For aloes had a part,
And when I think of the cross He bore, My eyes with teardrops start.

Out of the ivory palaces Into a world of woe,
Only His great eternal love Made my Saviour go.

His garments too were in cassia dipped, With healing in a touch,
Each time my feet in some sin have slipped, He took me from its clutch.

Out of the ivory palaces Into a world of woe,
Only His great eternal love Made my Saviour go.

In garments glorious He will come, To open wide the door;
And shall enter my heavʹnly home, To dwell forevermore.

Out of the ivory palaces Into a world of woe,
Only His great eternal love Made my Saviour go.

items.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross
verses:
When I survey the wondrous cross,
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ my God;
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

See, from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
Did eʹer such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown.

Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were a present far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

items.title: More Love to Thee, O Christ
verses:
Once earthIy joy I craved, Sought peace and rest,
Now Thee alone I seek, Give what is best;
This all my prayer shall be, More love, O Christ to Thee,
More love to Thee! More love to Thee!

items.title: Thy Life Was Given for Me
“None of Self and All of Thee”
verses:
Oh, the bitter pain and sorrow That a time could ever be,
When I proudly said to Jesus, “All of self, and none of Thee,”
All of self and none of Thee, All of self and none of Thee,
When I proudly said to Jesus, “All of self and one of Thee.”

Yet He found me; I beheld Him Bleeding on th’accursed tree;
And my wistful heart said faintly, “Some of self, and some of Thee,”
Some of self and some of Thee, Some of self and some of Thee,
And my wistful heart said faintly, “Some of self and some of Thee.”

Day by day His tender mercy Healing, helping, full and free,
Bro’t me lower while I whispered, “Less of self, and more of Thee,”
Less of self and more of Thee, Less of self and more of Thee,
Bro’t me lower while I whispered, “Less of self, and more of Thee.”

Higher than the highest heavens, Deeper than the deepest sea,
Lord, Thy love at last has conquered, “None of self, and all of Thee,”
None of self and all of Thee, None of self and all of Thee,
Lord, Thy love at last has conquered, “None of self, and all of Thee,”

items.title: O Blessed Son of God
verses:
O blessed Son of God,
In love and faith we plead
That Thou wouldst bind our minds and hearts
In brotherhood of need.

Our Elder Brother Thou,
Whose heritage we share,
Our kindred lives we offer Thee,
In brotherhood of prayer.

Thou didst the will of Him
Who sent Thee from above;
Thou sendest us as He sent Thee,
In brotherhood of love.

Thou Man of Galilee,
O wilt Thou live again,
Abide within, control, inspire
Our brotherhood of men.

items.title: I’d Rather Have Jesus
verses:
I’d rather have Jesus than silver or gold,
I’d rather be His than have riches untold,
I’d rather have Jesus than houses or lands,
I’d rather be led by His nail-pierced hand.

Than to be the king of a vast domain
Or be hled in sin’s dread sway.
I’d rather have Jesus than anything 
This world affords today.

I’d rather have Jesus than men’s applause,
I’d rather be faithfyl to His dear cause,
I’d rather have Jesus than worldwide fame,
I’d rather be true to His holy name.

Than to be the king of a vast domain
Or be hled in sin’s dread sway.
I’d rather have Jesus than anything 
This world affords today.

He’s fairer than lilies of rarest bloom,
He’s sweeter than honey from out the comb,
He’s all that my hungering spirit needs,
I’d rather have Jesus and let Him lead.

Than to be the king of a vast domain
Or be hled in sin’s dread sway.
I’d rather have Jesus than anything 
This world affords today.

items.title: My Jesus, I Love Thee
verses:
My Jesus, I love Thee, I know Thou art mine,
For Thee all the follies of sin I resign,
My gracious Redeemer, my Saviour art Thou,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, ‘tis now.

I love Thee because Thou hast first loved me,
And purchased my pardon on Calvary’s tree,
I love Thee for wearing the thorns on Thy brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, ‘tis now.

I’ll love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath,
And say when the death dew lies cold on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, ‘tis now.

In mansions of glory and endless delight,
I’ll ever adore Thee in heaven so bright,
I’ll sing with the glittering crown on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, ‘tis now.

items.title: To Follow in His Train
verses:
The Son of God goes forth to war, A kingly crown to gain,
His bloodred banner streams afar, Who follows in His trains?
Who best can drink His cup of woe, Triumphant over pain,
Who patient bears His cross below, He follows in His train.

The martyr first, whose eagle eye could pierce beyond the grave,
Who saw his Master in the sky, and called on Him to save.
Like Him, with pardon on his tonge, In mids of mortal pain,
He prayed for them that did the wrong, Who follows in his train?

A glorious band, the chosen few on whom the Spirit came,
Twelve valiant saints, their hope they knew, And mocked the cross and flame.
They met the tyrant’s brandished steel. The lion’s gory mane,
They bowed their heads the stroke to feel, Who follows in their train?

A noble army, men and boys, The matron and the maid,
Around the Saviour’s throne rejoice, In robes of light arrayed.
They climbed the steep ascent of heaven, Through peril, toil, and pain,
O God, to us may grace be given To follow in their train.

items.title: Jesus, Blessed Saviour
verses:
Jesus, blessed Saviour, I will follow Thee, 
For my sins you suffered, gave your life for me.
Now I have redemption, by Thy sacrifice,
I will seek Thy glorious prize.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, by Thy grace I’m freed.
By Thy loving mercy, I am now redeemed.
Joyously my heart sings in eternal praise,
Lord, be with me all my days.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, I am ever Thine,
Tho’ the road before me wanders steep and blind.
Keep me on the pathway, in Thy precious love,
As I near my home above.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, by Thy grace I’m freed.
By Thy loving mercy, I am now redeemed.
Joyously my heart sings in eternal praise,
Lord, be with me all my days.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, guide me in Thy way,
Keep me safe beside Thee, evermore to stay,
Never let me wander, keep me in Thy light,
Be with me both day and night.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, by Thy grace I’m freed.
By Thy loving mercy, I am now redeemed.
Joyously my heart sings in eternal praise,
Lord, be with me all my days.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, by Thy Spirit blest,
In your tender care I’ll find eternal rest,
Jesus, Saviour, keep me always by Thy side,
Let Thy grace in me abide.

Jesus, blessed Saviour, by Thy grace I’m freed.
By Thy loving mercy, I am now redeemed.
Joyously my heart sings in eternal praise,
Lord, be with me all my days.
